purpose: Make downstream-to-upstream engineering feedback explicit. A manufacturability, analysis, variation, drawing or inspection finding may reopen an engineering decision but may never silently edit a characteristic.
rules: Feedback creates an Engineering Feedback Record (EFR) and, when design intent changes, an EDR/change record before Product Definition mutation.
A downstream artifact cannot self-correct its upstream authority.
Disposition must identify which upstream stage is reopened and then run pre-change impact before write.
